'''September 2000 Vancouver tournament (17 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vancouver, BC on 17 September 2000. [[James Hsu]] won it. It is known from James Hsu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1252">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-19-the-real-vancouver-bc-9-17-00d1252/ the-real-vancouver-bc-9-17-00], DeckTech (James "Wraith One" Hsu, 19 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-19-the-real-vancouver-bc-9-17-00d1252/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[James Hsu]]
